newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - private.

text.p: Trade in Nebraska feedlot cattle was at a standstill Wednesday with most of the week's showlist already sold out, market sources said.
"There is not much left out there to trade," one source said. He estimated the week's sales at around 85,000 head out of the weekly showlist of 85,300.

Owners were pricing cattle mostly at $108 per cwt on a dressed basis, with "a few really good ones" at $109. Bids were at $106 and $107 per cwt. The bulk of sales on Tuesday were at $107 although some traded at $108, sources said.
There were no bids or offers reported on a live basis.
